name: CacheNamespace.java
summary: Enum of Redis/warehouse cache namespaces keyed by Peach chart type, mapping TradingView resolutions to table names, cache names, and bar periods.

name: ChartCacheStore.java
summary: Redis sorted-set cache for OHLC bars, with per-namespace locks, JSON encode/decode, and lazy warm-from-warehouse when a pair's key is empty.

name: ChartDataController.java
summary: REST controller exposing the TradingView UDF datafeed: health, config, server time, symbol search/resolve, marks, timescale marks, and history bars.

name: DatafeedConfigResponse.java
summary: Response DTO for the UDF /config endpoint, including supported exchanges, symbol types, resolutions, and feature flags.

name: HealthResponse.java
summary: Minimal health-check response carrying a status string for the datafeed liveness endpoint.

name: HistoryResponse.java
summary: UDF history response that converts OHLC bars into columnar t/o/h/l/c arrays, with factories for successful and empty (no-data / nextTime) results.

name: MarkDto.java
summary: DTO for a TradingView chart mark: id, timestamp, color, text, and label used by the /marks endpoint.

name: SearchSymbolDto.java
summary: DTO for one UDF symbol-search hit, including ticker, description, exchange, and type.

name: ServerTimeResponse.java
summary: Response wrapping Unix epoch seconds for the UDF /time endpoint.

name: SymbolInfoDto.java
summary: Resolved symbol metadata for TradingView: ticker, session, timezone, price scale, and supported resolutions.

name: TimescaleMarkDto.java
summary: DTO for a TradingView timescale mark: id, time, color, label, and tooltip list for the /timescale_marks endpoint.

name: Season.java
summary: JPA entity for daylight-saving versus standard-time seasons, with start/end instants used to pick the FX trading session string.

name: TvMark.java
summary: JPA entity for persisted TradingView chart marks keyed by currency pair, resolution, and timestamp.

name: TvTimescaleMark.java
summary: JPA entity for persisted TradingView timescale marks keyed by currency pair, resolution, and timestamp.

name: SeasonRepository.java
summary: Spring Data repository that finds the current season overlapping a given instant among daylight-saving and standard codes.

name: TvMarkRepository.java
summary: Spring Data repository querying chart marks for a pair and resolution within a time window, ordered by mark time.

name: TvTimescaleMarkRepository.java
summary: Spring Data repository querying timescale marks for a pair and resolution within a time window, ordered by mark time.

name: ChartDataService.java
summary: Service interface for the TradingView datafeed: config, server time, symbol search/resolve, marks, timescale marks, and OHLC history.

name: ChartDataServiceImpl.java
summary: Implements the UDF datafeed: validates requests, resolves FX pairs and sessions, loads marks from the database, and serves history bars from the Redis cache.

name: ResolutionMapper.java
summary: Maps TradingView resolution strings to Peach chart types and period milliseconds, and validates history versus marks resolution sets.

name: ChartBackendApplication.java
summary: Spring Boot entry point that starts the TradingView chart backend and enables AppProperties configuration binding.

name: AppProperties.java
summary: Binds the app prefix from application.yml: CORS origins, JWT secret/TTLs, and TradingView datafeed flags used by auth and chart config.

name: AppUserSeedRunner.java
summary: Boot-time ApplicationRunner that inserts demo and demo2 local users into m_app_user with BCrypt passwords when those usernames are missing.

name: AuthController.java
summary: REST controller for POST /api/auth/login, refresh, and logout; delegates JWT and cookie handling to AuthService.

name: LoginRequest.java
summary: JSON body for POST /api/auth/login carrying the demo username and password used to mint a local JWT.

name: LoginResponse.java
summary: Successful login payload with Bearer access token, token type, and access/refresh expiry seconds; refresh token stays in a cookie.

name: RefreshResponse.java
summary: Refresh-endpoint body with a new Bearer access token and expiry seconds after cookie rotation.

name: AppUser.java
summary: JPA entity for local demo logins mapped to m_app_user, including BCrypt hash, enabled flag, and tenant customer_no.

name: BadCredentialsAppException.java
summary: Runtime exception thrown on failed login when the user is missing, disabled, or the BCrypt password does not match.

name: UnauthorizedAppException.java
summary: Runtime exception for missing or invalid refresh cookies during token rotation, distinct from bad-password login failures.

name: AppUserRepository.java
summary: Spring Data JPA repository for m_app_user lookups by username used on login and demo-user seeding.

name: AuthCookieSupport.java
summary: Helpers that set, clear, and read the HttpOnly Lax chart_refresh_token cookie on servlet responses and requests.

name: JwtService.java
summary: Creates and parses HS256 access JWTs using AppProperties.jwt secret and access TTL, embedding username and customer_no.

name: RefreshTokenSession.java
summary: In-memory identity parsed from a Redis refresh key (username plus customerNo) used only to mint a new access JWT.

name: RefreshTokenStore.java
summary: Redis store for opaque refresh UUIDs: issue, find, revoke, and rotate keys under peach:auth:refresh with JWT refresh TTL.

name: AuthService.java
summary: Service contract for local username/password login, refresh-cookie rotation, and logout used by AuthController.

name: AuthServiceImpl.java
summary: Authenticates against m_app_user with BCrypt, issues HS256 access JWTs, and manages Redis refresh cookies for login, refresh, and logout.

name: DemoTickEngine.java
summary: Simulates live FX quotes for every warehouse currency pair by walking bid/ask from last 1s bars or DemoMarket seeds, then exposing stepped ticks and snapshots for ingest.

name: QuoteBus.java
summary: Publishes live FX quotes and forming OHLC bars to Redis as JSON, writing last-value keys and broadcasting on dedicated channels.

name: TickIngestWorker.java
summary: Startup and scheduled worker that drives DemoTickEngine, upserts open bars across cache namespaces, and publishes quotes and forming bars on QuoteBus.

name: CurrencyPairController.java
summary: REST controller exposing the active FX currency-pair catalog used by chart symbol pickers.

name: CurrencyPairDto.java
summary: API and cache-facing DTO carrying numeric pair code, display name, and sort priority for FX symbols.

name: FormingBarMessage.java
summary: Redis/WebSocket payload for the in-progress OHLC bar of a symbol at a given TradingView resolution.

name: FxQuoteMessage.java
summary: Live tick payload with bid, ask, mid, and session high/low used by QuoteBus and the demo tick engine.

name: Ccypair.java
summary: JPA entity for warehouse currency pairs, including Japanese name, rate unit, delete flag, and display priority.

name: CcypairRepository.java
summary: Spring Data repository for active currency pairs: lookup by code, priority-ordered lists, and name search.

name: CurrencyPairService.java
summary: Service contract for listing active FX pairs and resolving one pair by numeric code.

name: CurrencyPairServiceImpl.java
summary: Loads active Ccypair rows, maps them to CurrencyPairDto, and formats six-letter codes as XXX/YYY display names.

name: SymbolCatalogImpl.java
summary: Builds the TradingView symbol catalog from currency pairs and AppProperties exchange/type, then resolves symbols by ticker aliases.

name: DemoMarket.java
summary: Static FX demo-market helpers for price scale, seed bid/mid, bar amplitude, spreads, and wicks, with JPY-quote vs majors branching.

name: ErrorCodes.java
summary: Central catalog of API error code strings and i18n message keys for validation, not-found, server, unauthorized, and bad-credentials failures.

name: ErrorResponse.java
summary: JSON error payload DTO with an error code and localized message, constructed via a static factory.

name: GlobalExceptionHandler.java
summary: Spring REST advice that maps domain exceptions to HTTP statuses and localized ErrorResponse bodies.

name: ResourceNotFoundException.java
summary: Runtime exception thrown when a requested chart resource cannot be found, carrying the NOT_FOUND error code.

name: ServerErrorException.java
summary: Runtime exception for unexpected internal failures, carrying the SERVER error code.

name: ValidationException.java
summary: Runtime exception for request validation failures, carrying the VALIDATION error code.

name: CustomerContext.java
summary: Thread-local holder for the authenticated customer number, used by layout and template services to scope data.

name: JsonUnauthorizedEntryPoint.java
summary: Spring Security entry point that writes a JSON 401 ErrorResponse using the request locale instead of a redirect.

name: LocalizedMessageService.java
summary: Service interface for resolving i18n message keys to locale-specific strings used in error responses.

name: LocalizedMessageServiceImpl.java
summary: Resolves message-bundle keys through Spring MessageSource using LocaleContextHolder.

name: ChartLayoutController.java
summary: REST controller at /api/layouts that exposes register, update, list, get, and delete endpoints for saved TradingView chart layouts (design docs 127–131).

name: RegisterChartLayoutRequest.java
summary: Request body for POST and PUT /api/layouts: layout name, widget JSON content, currency-pair symbol, and resolution.

name: ChartLayoutDto.java
summary: Full layout payload for GET /api/layouts/{id}, including widget content and updated_at as unix seconds.

name: ChartLayoutIdResponse.java
summary: Id-only response returned after register or update so the client can fetch or update the layout later.

name: ChartLayoutListItemDto.java
summary: Metadata-only list row for GET /api/layouts: id, name, resolution, symbol, and timestamp without widget content.

name: TvChartLayout.java
summary: JPA entity for table m_tv_chart_layout storing one customer's saved widget layout, pair code, resolution, and update time.

name: TvChartLayoutRepository.java
summary: Spring Data JPA repository for m_tv_chart_layout, adding a customer-scoped list ordered by newest updated_at.

name: ChartLayoutService.java
summary: Service contract for tenant-scoped chart-layout register, update, get, list, and delete used by ChartLayoutController.

name: ChartLayoutServiceImpl.java
summary: Transactional implementation of layout CRUD: validates body and resolution, requires an active pair, and hides other tenants' ids as 404.

name: IndicatorTemplateController.java
summary: REST controller exposing list, upsert, get, and delete endpoints for TradingView study (indicator) templates under /api/indicator-templates.

name: UpsertIndicatorTemplateRequest.java
summary: Request body for POST /api/indicator-templates carrying template name and study JSON content.

name: IndicatorTemplateDto.java
summary: GET-by-name response payload containing one study template's name and content for the JWT customer.

name: IndicatorTemplateListItemDto.java
summary: Name-only list-row DTO for GET /api/indicator-templates, omitting the study content blob.

name: SystemDatetimeResponse.java
summary: Shared unix-seconds timestamp payload used by indicator, layout, and chart-template upsert/delete responses.

name: TvIndicatorTemplate.java
summary: JPA entity mapping m_tv_indicator_template, uniquely keyed by customer_no and name, holding study JSON content.

name: TvIndicatorTemplateRepository.java
summary: Spring Data JPA repository for listing and loading customer-scoped indicator templates by name.

name: IndicatorTemplateService.java
summary: Service contract for tenant-scoped indicator-template list, upsert, get, and delete operations.

name: IndicatorTemplateServiceImpl.java
summary: Transactional implementation of indicator-template CRUD, scoping rows by JWT customer and validating name length.

name: ChartTemplateController.java
summary: REST controller for TradingView chart-style templates at /api/chart-templates, covering list, upsert, get, and delete (design docs 136–139).

name: UpsertChartTemplateRequest.java
summary: Request body for POST /api/chart-templates carrying template name and TradingView chart-style JSON content.

name: ChartTemplateDto.java
summary: GET-by-name response payload with a chart template's name and widget content for the JWT customer.

name: ChartTemplateListItemDto.java
summary: Name-only list row for GET /api/chart-templates, omitting content so clients can present a sorted template picker.

name: TvChartTemplate.java
summary: JPA entity for m_tv_chart_templates storing per-customer TradingView chart-style presets unique on (customer_no, name).

name: TvChartTemplateRepository.java
summary: Spring Data JPA repository for listing a customer's chart templates by name and loading one row by (customer_no, name).

name: ChartTemplateService.java
summary: Service contract for tenant CRUD of chart templates keyed by (customer_no, name), used by ChartTemplateController.

name: ChartTemplateServiceImpl.java
summary: Transactional ChartTemplateService implementation that validates names, scopes rows by JWT customer, and upserts content on m_tv_chart_templates.

name: CachedChartBar.java
summary: Immutable cache row holding dual bid/ask OHLC for one FX candle, used by tick ingest to form bars and by history to map a price side into BarDto.

name: ChartCacheWriter.java
summary: Startup seeder that fills warehouse tables and Redis cache with deterministic historical bars for every FX symbol and timeframe once at boot.

name: PriceComponent.java
summary: Enumerates BID, ASK, and MID price sides for history and mock bars, with lenient and strict parsers for the bid_ask query parameter.

name: BarDto.java
summary: Internal OHLCV bar DTO used when mapping cache rows toward GET /api/history; time is unix milliseconds at candle open and is not the columnar JSON payload.

name: MockBarGenerator.java
summary: Service interface for deterministic mock OHLCV used only to boot-seed warehouse and Redis caches, not for live tick ingest.

name: SymbolCatalog.java
summary: In-memory FX symbol catalog interface that resolves widget tickers to provider symbols, price scale, and pair codes for history and ingest.

name: MockBarGeneratorImpl.java
summary: Deterministic sine-and-hash mock bar factory that seeds historical BID/ASK/MID candles and Peach cache rows from DemoMarket parameters.

summary: Flyway V1 migration that creates the currency-pair master table used as the FX symbol catalog for charts and quotes.

name: m_ccypairs
summary: Master table of FX currency pairs with Japanese name, rate unit, soft-delete flag, and display priority.

name: V2__create_m_season.sql
summary: Flyway V2 migration that creates the season master table for trading calendar windows.

name: m_season
summary: Season master storing a season code and inclusive start/end timestamps for chart or market windows.

name: V3__create_m_tv_mark.sql
summary: Flyway V3 migration that creates the TradingView bar-mark table for per-symbol, per-resolution chart annotations.

name: m_tv_mark
summary: Stores TradingView marks keyed by currency pair and resolution, with timestamp, color, label, and mark text.

name: V4__create_m_tv_timescale_mark.sql
summary: Flyway V4 migration that creates the TradingView timescale-mark table for time-axis annotations.

name: m_tv_timescale_mark
summary: Stores TradingView timescale marks keyed by currency pair and resolution, with color, label, and tooltip.

name: V5__create_m_tv_chart_layout.sql
summary: Flyway V5 migration that creates the per-customer TradingView chart layout persistence table.

name: m_tv_chart_layout
summary: Persists saved chart layouts per customer, including JSON content, symbol, chart type, and last update time.

name: V6__create_m_tv_indicator_template.sql
summary: Flyway V6 migration that creates the per-customer TradingView indicator template table.

name: m_tv_indicator_template
summary: Stores named indicator templates per customer as JSON content with an updated-at timestamp.

name: V7__create_m_app_user.sql
summary: Flyway V7 migration that creates the application user table for login credentials and customer binding.

name: m_app_user
summary: Application users with username, password hash, customer number, enabled flag, and created-at timestamp.

name: t_chart_60
summary: 1-minute OHLC fact table storing bid/ask open-high-low-close and volume keyed by currency pair and bar time.

name: t_chart_300
summary: 5-minute OHLC fact table storing bid/ask open-high-low-close and volume keyed by currency pair and bar time.

name: t_chart_600
summary: 10-minute OHLC fact table storing bid/ask open-high-low-close and volume keyed by currency pair and bar time.

name: t_chart_900
summary: 15-minute OHLC fact table storing bid/ask open-high-low-close and volume keyed by currency pair and bar time.

name: t_chart_1800
summary: 30-minute OHLC fact table storing bid/ask open-high-low-close and volume keyed by currency pair and bar time.

name: t_chart_3600
summary: 1-hour OHLC fact table storing bid/ask open-high-low-close and volume keyed by currency pair and bar time.

name: t_chart_7200
summary: 2-hour OHLC fact table storing bid/ask open-high-low-close and volume keyed by currency pair and bar time.

name: t_chart_14400
summary: 4-hour OHLC fact table storing bid/ask open-high-low-close and volume keyed by currency pair and bar time.

name: t_chart_28800
summary: 8-hour OHLC fact table storing bid/ask open-high-low-close and volume keyed by currency pair and bar time.

name: t_chart_day
summary: Daily OHLC fact table storing bid/ask open-high-low-close and volume keyed by currency pair and bar time.

name: t_chart_week
summary: Weekly OHLC fact table storing bid/ask open-high-low-close and volume keyed by currency pair and bar time.

name: t_chart_month
summary: Monthly OHLC fact table storing bid/ask open-high-low-close and volume keyed by currency pair and bar time.

name: V9__create_m_tv_chart_templates.sql
summary: Flyway V9 migration that creates the per-customer TradingView chart template table.

name: m_tv_chart_templates
summary: Stores named chart templates per customer as JSON content with an updated-at timestamp.

summary: Maven POM for chart-backend: Spring Boot 4.0.7 on Java 21 with web, JPA, Flyway, Redis, Security, JJWT, and springdoc OpenAPI.

name: README.md
summary: Mentor-facing class map of com.task.chart covering CTFX layering, datafeed docs 120–139, cache SSOT, and a full Java file tree.

summary: Springdoc OpenAPI bean that titles the CTFX Chart Backend, tags docs 120–139 plus auth and currency pairs, and registers a Bearer JWT scheme.

name: PasswordConfig.java
summary: Registers a BCryptPasswordEncoder bean used by login to hash and verify demo user passwords.

name: MarkSeedWindow.java
summary: Fixed unix FROM/TO window used when seeding demo marks and timescale marks for datafeed docs 125 and 126.

name: package-info.java
summary: Package javadoc for com.task.chart describing controller-service-repository layering, live ingest SSOT, and the Java README map.

summary: Authenticated chart user record carrying username and tenant customerNo taken from the access JWT.

name: JwtAuthenticationFilter.java
summary: OncePerRequestFilter that parses Bearer access JWTs, sets SecurityContext and CustomerContext, and clears both after the request.
